'''Ikanashi Shrine''' (伊加奈志神社) is a Shinto shrine located in [[:en:Imabari|Imabari]], {{ill|Ehime Prefecture|ace|Prefektur Ehime|af|Ehime-prefektuur|an|Prefectura d'Ehime|ar|إهيمه (محافظة)|az|Ehime prefekturası|azb|اهیمه اوستانی|ban|Préféktur Éhimé|be|Эхімэ|bg|Ехиме|bn|এহিমে প্রশাসনিক অঞ্চল|ca|Prefectura d'Ehime|cdo|Ehime-gâing|ce|Эхиме (префектура)|ceb|Ehime-ken|ckb|پارێزگای ئێھیمێ|cs|Prefektura Ehime|cy|Ehime (talaith)|da|Ehime-præfekturet|de|Präfektur Ehime|eo|Gubernio Ehime|es|Prefectura de Ehime|et|Ehime prefektuur|eu|Ehime (prefektura)|fa|استان اهیمه|fi|Ehimen prefektuuri|fr|Préfecture d'Ehime|frr|Ehime-ken|ga|Maoracht Ehime|gl|Prefectura de Ehime|hak|Ehime-yen|he|אהימה (מחוז)|hr|Ehime (prefektura)|hu|Ehime prefektúra|hy|Էհիմե (պրեֆեկտուրա)|id|Prefektur Ehime|ilo|Prepektura ti Ehime|it|Prefettura di Ehime|ja|愛媛県|jv|Préfèktur Ehime|ka|ეჰიმეს პრეფექტურა|km|អិហ៊ីម៉ិ(ខេត្ត)|ko|에히메현|lt|Ehimės prefektūra|lv|Ehimes prefektūra|mk|Ехиме (префектура)|mni|ꯏꯍꯤꯃꯦ ꯂꯝꯈꯥꯢ|mr|एहिमे प्रांत|ms|Wilayah Ehime|ne|एहिमे|nl|Ehime|no|Ehime (prefektur)|os|Эхиме|pam|Prepektura ning Ehime|pl|Prefektura Ehime|pnb|ضلع اہیمے|pt|Ehime|ro|Prefectura Ehime|ru|Эхиме|sco|Ehime Prefectur|sd|اهيمه پريفيڪچر|se|Ehime prefektuvra|sh|Prefektura Ehime|si|එහිමේ ප්‍රාන්තය|simple|Ehime Prefecture|sk|Ehime (prefektúra)|sr|Префектура Ехиме|su|Préféktur Ehime|sv|Ehime prefektur|sw|Mkoa wa Ehime|tg|Префектураи Эҳиме|th|จังหวัดเอฮิเมะ|tl|Prepektura ng Ehime|tr|Ehime|tt|Эхиме (префектура)|uk|Префектура Ехіме|ur|اہیمے پریفیکچر|vi|Ehime|war|Ehime (prefektura)|wuu|爱媛县|zh|爱媛县|zh_classical|愛媛縣|zh_min_nan|Ehime-koān|zh_yue|愛媛縣|qid=Q123376|lt=Ehime Prefecture}}, Japan. It is considered a provincial shrine (総社) of {{ill|Iyo Province|cs|Provincie Ijo|de|Provinz Iyo|es|Provincia de Iyo|fa|ولایت ایو|fi|Iyon provinssi|fr|Province d'Iyo|gl|Provincia de Iyo|id|Provinsi Iyo|it|Iyo (provincia)|ja|伊予国|ko|이요국|lt|Ijo žemė|min|Provinsi Iyo|nl|Iyo (provincie)|pt|Província de Iyo|ru|Иё (провинция)|sh|Iyo (provincija)|simple|Iyo Province|sk|Ijo (provincia)|sr|Провинција Ијо|tr|Iyo (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Ійо|zh|伊予國|zh_min_nan|Iyo-kok|qid=Q907829|lt=Iyo Province}} and a {{ill|Engishiki|ja|延喜式神名帳}} shrine.

== Enshrined Deities ==
* Five Pillars of Creation (Five Heavenly Kami)
* Ikatarashihiko-no-Mikoto (いかたらしひこのみこと), identified as a prince of {{ill|Emperor Suinin|en|Emperor Suinin|qid=Q314850|lt=Emperor Suinin}}
* Ikagasikooro-no-Mikoto (いかがしこおのみこと), believed to be an ancestral deity of the {{ill|Mononobe clan|en|Mononobe clan|qid=Q1755836|lt=Mononobe clan}}

== History ==
The shrine is listed in the {{ill|Engishiki|ja|延喜式神名帳}} under {{ill|Ochi District, Ehime|ceb|Ochi-gun|es|Distrito de Ochi (Ehime)|fr|District d'Ochi (Ehime)|id|Distrik Ochi, Ehime|it|Distretto di Ochi|ja|越智郡|ko|오치군 (에히메현)|pl|Powiat Ochi|uk|Повіт Очі|zh|越智郡|qid=Q1206502|lt=Ochi District, Iyo Province}}. Historically known as "Sosha Myojin" (総社明神), the shrine's proximity to the Soja River (蒼社川) reflects its importance as a regional spiritual center. The name "Ikanashi" is thought to derive from "Ikagasiko," a reference to the enshrined deity.

The shrine's documents and treasures were lost in a fire during the {{ill|Ansei|cs|Ansei|de|Ansei|es|Ansei|fa|آنسی (دوره)|fr|Ère Ansei|ia|Ansei|it|Ansei|ja|安政|ko|안세이|ru|Ансэй|simple|Ansei|sr|Ансеи|sv|Ansei|tr|Ansei|zh|安政|qid=Q1327259|lt=Ansei era}} (1854–1860).

== Grounds ==
; main hall
; Worship Hall
; Sub-Shrines
* Yamano-no-Kami Shrine: Dedicated to {{ill|Ōyamatsumi|abstract|Q386563|az|Ooyamatsimu|de|Ōyamatsumi|fa|اویاماتسومی|fr|Ōyamatsumi|hr|O-Yama-Tsu-mi|ja|オオヤマツミ|ko|오야마쓰미노카미|mni|ꯑꯣꯌꯃꯠꯁꯨꯃꯤ|ru|Ооямацуми|simple|Ōyamatsumi|sv|Ōyamatsumi|tr|Ōyamatsumi|zh|大山津見|qid=Q386563|lt=Oyamatsumi}}
* Okuninushi Shrine: Dedicated to [[Ōkuninushi]]
* Munakata Shrine: Dedicated to the {{ill|Three Munakata Goddesses|ja|宗像三女神|ko|무나카타 삼여신|simple|Three Munakata goddesses|zh|宗像三女神|qid=Q10948069}}

The nearby summit of the mountain hosts {{ill|Iwashimizu-Hachiman Shrine|ja|石清水八幡神社 (今治市)|qid=Q55535314}}.

== festivals ==
The shrine's festival takes place on October 10. A lottery system determines the heads of the shrine's organizing groups (10-household units) for the following year, and the festival is led by the selected leader (当屋). A kagami (mirror) ritual and mochi offering are central components.

In addition to the festival, an early seedling festival (早苗祭) is held around {{ill|Hachijūhachiya|ja|八十八夜|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/88th night|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11390609}}, when prayers for a bountiful harvest are made.
